tt-metal#56526 `ttnn.quantize` / `ttnn.requantize` with the default int32 output never produce −128: everything at or below −127.5 saturates to −127 (`FP32_TO_INT8` has a 7-bit magnitude), while the int8 output and the torch golden give −128 (simulator measurement)

tt-metal#56525 `ttnn.quantize` / `ttnn.requantize` (fused path): exact half-way points round away from zero (int32 output) or toward +∞ (int8/uint8), not to nearest even — 14.5 % of a bf16 `randn` tensor differs from `torch.quantize_per_tensor` at scale 2⁻⁶ (simulator measurement)

tt-metal#56522 `ttnn.where` (float32): a `-0.0` predicate selects the *true* branch — the SFPU kernel tests the raw bit pattern against zero, so `-0.0 != 0`, where torch and ttnn's own golden (`torch.ne(predicate, 0)`) select the false branch
